ops.title: recheck-self-address handoff: card recheck posts as board-watch (#3667)
ops.body:
Lane recheck-self-address, brief /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/meta-desk-3/b/recheck-self-address.md.

Cause: rulings.py classify ran `lr board cards recheck --lane root`. The recheck's lane report to a card root drew (CardRef.Lane == root) and the tap withdraw (Cards.Withdraw, hardcoded To root) both addressed root from root, which cci refuses; the first refusal aborts the recheck.

Fix: PR yasyf/cc-skills#3667 https://github.com/yasyf/cc-skills/pull/3667, head b41f64a32d819183a400b01dff21bc3550e35c37, branch recheck-self-address, worktree /Users/yasyf/repos/claude/worktrees/cc-skills/recheck-self-address.
- rulings.py: the recheck and its WARN line use `--lane board_rows.OWNER_LANE` (board-watch), the lane board_watch.py's pick recheck already uses. board-watch is a DeskLane and a machine author, so prose checks skip it as they skipped root.
- deps_test.go: fixture posts as board-watch and refuses a self-addressed record as cci does; new test TestARulingRecheckReachesTheRootThatDrewACardAndWithdrawsItsTapToRoot.
- test_rulings.py: classify asserts `--lane board-watch`.

State at 12:51 PM: CI run 42290850673 on b41f64a, all green except lr-go still running.

Remaining: once lr-go is green, `ccx vcs merge 3667 -R yasyf/cc-skills --admin --match-head-commit b41f64a32d819183a400b01dff21bc3550e35c37`; post `cci post --kind landed --pr 3667 --lane recheck-self-address --to meta-desk-3,install-desk`; post done to meta-desk-3; SendMessage meta-desk-3 the PR and merge sha.
